description.en: Bank checks, payment evidence, cash movements and reconciliation exceptions without moving money.
description.zh-CN: 管理银行走查、付款依据、收付流水和对账异常。

agentPrompts: List active bank accounts and their last checked date; flag stale balances and restricted accounts without treating book balances as live bank data.
Compare each daily check with its book balance and bank evidence; list discrepancies and stale checks without inventing adjustments.
Review pending, approved and blocked payments, separating approval from actual payment and flagging missing invoice or bank receipt references.
